FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Voici' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. Here is
   C. the father
   D. the sister

2. What does 'C'est le bébé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandfather.
   B. It is the baby.
   C. This is my brother.
   D. This is my father.

3. What does 'Excusez-moi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome
   B. Excuse me
   C. Go
   D. Turn

4. How do you say 'Put the book in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le livre est sur la table.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

5. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: Where is the rug? (1 mark)
   A. in front of the sofa
   B. under the table
   C. in the kitchen
   D. behind the TV

6. Which little word goes with 'grand-mère' (the grandmother)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. le

7. What number is 'quatre' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 8
   C. 14
   D. 4

8. How do you say the month 'March' in French? (1 mark)
   A. octobre
   B. mars
   C. novembre
   D. mai

9. What does 'Enchanté !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Njeri.
   B. Good evening, Madam!
   C. Pleased to meet you!
   D. Goodbye, Sir.

10. What does 'C'est un lit.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The ball is behind the door.
   B. It is a bed.
   C. It is a table.
   D. Here is my house.

11. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'February'? (1 mark)
   A. févrer
   B. fèvrier
   C. février
   D. fevrier

12. How do you say 'the day' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jour
   B. l'église
   C. la semaine
   D. l'école

13. Which little word goes with 'mangue' (the mango)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

14. The zh sound in French is most like the sound in which English word? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. measure
   C. jump
   D. ship

15. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker eat in the evening? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. cake
   C. bread
   D. chicken

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est sous la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into English: 'C'est ma sœur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'My sister is called Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'I like milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Voici ma maison.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Write and read aloud a short greeting for a card to a girl called Njeri. Write what you would say. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Here is
   Voici means Here is.

2. B — It is the baby.
   C'est le bébé. means It is the baby.

3. B — Excuse me
   Excusez-moi means Excuse me.

4. D — Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   Put the book in the bedroom. in French is Mets le livre dans la chambre.

5. A — in front of the sofa
   Le tapis est devant le canapé.

6. A — la
   grand-mère is feminine, so we say la grand-mère.

7. D — 4
   quatre means 4.

8. B — mars
   March in French is mars.

9. C — Pleased to meet you!
   Enchanté ! means Pleased to meet you!

10. B — It is a bed.
   C'est un lit. means It is a bed.

11. C — février
   The correct spelling is février, with its accents.

12. A — le jour
   the day in French is le jour.

13. C — la
   mangue is feminine, so we say la mangue.

14. B — measure
   The s in measure is the same soft zh sound as the French j.

15. A — fish
   Le soir, je mange du poisson.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: The rug is under the table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my sister.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'aime le lait.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Here is my house.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour, Njeri ! Ça va ? Au revoir !
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for her name, 1 mark for an extra correct phrase.
